facts.text: Pine Cliffs Residence sits at the top of the cliffs at Falesia Beach, with views over the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Pine Cliffs Residence is located at the top of the cliffs at Falésia Beach, a unique setting that offers exclusive beautiful views over the Atlantic Ocean

facts.text: Accommodation is in two- and three-bedroom apartments.
facts.excerpt: Choose from two- and three- bedroom apartments in this outstanding five-star resort in the Algarve

facts.text: The apartments have generous living areas, kitchenettes, laundry facilities and furnished outdoor terraces.
facts.excerpt: With generous living areas, ultra-comfortable master bedrooms, impeccable kitchenettes, laundry facilities, and furnished outdoor terraces

facts.text: The apartments are decorated with indigenous Algarvian elements.
facts.excerpt: The apartments are generously sized and decorated with indigenous algarvian elements

facts.text: The apartments are in a secluded area of the resort, surrounded by pine trees and gardens.
facts.excerpt: The apartments are located in a secluded area, surrounded by pine trees and exuberant gardens

facts.text: The Residence is set next to the golf course and surrounded by the resort's landscaped gardens.
facts.excerpt: Set next to the golf course and surrounded by the landscaped gardens of this luxury resort in the Algarve

facts.text: Falesia Beach is reached almost exclusively by a lift within the resort that leads to a wooden pathway between the cliffs.
facts.excerpt: This nature's gem is almost exclusively accessed by a lift located within the resort that leads to a wood pathway in between the cliffs.

facts.text: Falesia Beach is set against dramatic red cliffs.
facts.excerpt: Falesia Beach's unique setting with the dramatic red cliffs and the deep blue ocean

facts.text: On the beach, guests find the Mare at Pine Cliffs beach bar and sunbeds.
facts.excerpt: Arriving at the beach, guests will find our beach bar Maré at Pine Cliffs and sunbeds

facts.text: Serenity Spa is on site at Pine Cliffs Residence.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Serenity Spa is located on-site at Pine Cliffs Residence, a Luxury Collection Resort, Algarve.

facts.text: Serenity Spa offers couples experiences.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a massage in Albufeira, surprise your partner with a couples experience, or pamper yourself with a special spa package.

facts.text: The resort's 9-hole, par-33 Pine Cliffs Golf Course runs through a pinewood forest on a cliff-top above the Algarve coast.
facts.excerpt: The 9-hole, par-33 course winds its way through a pinewood forest on a cliff-top high above the enchanting Algarve coast.

facts.text: The Pine Cliffs Golf Course was designed by Martin Hawtree.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Martin Hawtree

facts.text: The resort offers indoor and outdoor swimming pools and padel and tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: indoor and outdoor swimming pools, padel and tennis courts and much more

facts.text: The Porto Pirata kids' club has life-size pirate ships.
facts.excerpt: Explore our Porto Pirata kids' club with life-size pirate ships at Pine Cliffs.

facts.text: Porto Pirata offers supervised child care for children from 6 months to 8 years old.
facts.excerpt: offers child care service for children from 6 months old to 8 years old. This service is supervised by an experienced and qualified team.

facts.text: The Annabel Croft Tennis Academy offers floodlit courts and coaching.
facts.excerpt: Annabel Croft Tennis Academy has 5 floodlit courts and coaching.

facts.text: In summer, water sports such as jet-ski, kayak and stand up paddle are offered at Falesia Beach.
facts.excerpt: During summertime we provide several water sports activities at Falesia Beach. From jet-ski, kayak, stand up paddle, banana ride, pedal boat and many others.

facts.text: The concierge team is led by Hugo Viegas, a member of Les Clefs d'Or.
facts.excerpt: the experienced advice of our Concierge team leaded by Hugo Viegas, member of Clef D'Or Association

facts.text: Groceries can be ordered from The Deli before arrival and placed in your apartment.
facts.excerpt: Products can also be shopped previous to your arrival and will be placed in your apartment.

facts.text: Yakuza by Olivier blends Japanese tradition with Mediterranean influence.
facts.excerpt: Japanese tradition meets Mediterranean influence in one of the Algarve

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the Residences are set apart on the other side of the golf course and suit groups needing two bedrooms or more.
facts.excerpt: Anyone traveling with a gang needing two bedrooms or more can check into the Residences, set apart on the other side of the golf course.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the Residences' rooms as having old-school continental elegance, with vast canopy beds and big sitting rooms.
facts.excerpt: The rooms here have a kind of old-school continental elegance to them, vast beds with canopies, big sitting rooms

facts.text: The closest airport is Faro Airport.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Pine Cliffs Residence, a Luxury Collection Resort, Algarve is Faro Airport (FAO).

facts.text: Porto Pirata Kid's Club services are subject to seasonal availability, while the playground is open all year.
facts.excerpt: All services of Porto Pirata Kid's Club are subject to seasonal availability, the playground is open all year-round.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler advises booking the smarter resort restaurants at least a couple of days in advance.
facts.excerpt: you need to book at least a couple of days in advance if you want to score a table at one of the smarter restaurants
